test_title: PYST 3: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: HJLI is related to OQSP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, BDFC is related to IKMJ. To which of the following is NPRO related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'HJLI' is related to 'OQSP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5964e749d3c03e2b3f775afbfd484c40e34c3efc2398a337332b32bf4642801.png] 

For, 'BDFC' is related to 'IKMJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88e44b80672a036630b09dd1aeada01722a75914791074b12d25713dc3901333.png] 

Similarly, for '**NPRO**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9106313ccb31e87ab44be5b3f5dd6ad4d007294f9c6211a3bfc442e922f2dd3.png] 

So, 'NPRO' will be related to '**UWYV**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
